verdict.rationale: xAI's image-understanding docs say some models accept images as input and consider their content when responding, which is first-party support for interpreting shared images. The support is only a thin, hedged mention ("some models"), with nothing on screenshot or photo uploads in the Grok app and no evidence of accuracy. Missing for 10: documentation of screenshot/photo upload in the Grok chat app, which models support vision, evidence of interpretation accuracy (OCR, charts, UI screenshots), independent or hands-on corroboration.
